cases.name: generation-content
cases.expectation: Generate two distinct Word specs with paragraphs/bullets/tables; inspect actual ZIP text/order, not only extension or hash.

cases.name: exact-text
cases.expectation: TXT preserves tabs, blank lines, Unicode and final newline exactly; empty and whitespace content obey explicit typed admission.

cases.name: workbook-types
cases.expectation: Multiple sheets preserve literal text, numbers, booleans and defined empty cells; formula-looking text must not become executable formula unintentionally.

cases.name: workbook-formulas
cases.expectation: Explicit supported formulas/cache metadata and cross-sheet references are preserved; absent recalculation cannot be labelled recalculated/validated.

cases.name: slides-content
cases.expectation: Multiple editable slides with bullets/table retain ordered text and slide count through actual adopted generator if available; absence remains UNRUN.

cases.name: analysis-data
cases.expectation: At least two input datasets exercise actual supported transformations, independent expected totals, missing-data and numeric-boundary outcomes; provenance maps input IDs.

cases.name: analysis-code
cases.expectation: Code/executable/module/path/network selectors are refused before any local child; supported transformations never imply general Python support.

cases.name: new-version
cases.expectation: Create yields exact byte/hash/media/object tuple and new immutable artifact version; output detached from port/request mutations.

cases.name: revision-lineage
cases.expectation: Revise requires exact base artifact/version and expected head; new parent points to prior version; original spec and bytes remain unchanged.

cases.name: revision-conflict
cases.expectation: Changed base hash/object/storage version or stale CAS fails without mutating originals; uncertain commit remains explicit and no blind retry.

cases.name: scope-binding
cases.expectation: Wrong tenant/actor/conversation/run/fence or ungranted evidence scope refuses before execution/storage/download as applicable.

cases.name: current-authority
cases.expectation: Revocation between generation and commit or between metadata read and download prevents new publication/disclosure.

cases.name: provenance
cases.expectation: Unknown/duplicate evidence references and content hash mismatches do not become cited verified facts; unverified input labels remain explicit.

cases.name: filename
cases.expectation: Absolute paths, traversal, separators, NUL/control chars, ambiguous extensions and unsupported output formats refuse before executor.

cases.name: archive-boundary
cases.expectation: External links/macros/unsupported package parts, ZIP expansion and symlinks are rejected or explicitly unsupported on admitted existing-artifact paths.

cases.name: renderer-claims
cases.expectation: Archive/text inspection cannot alone yield per-page/per-slide preview validation; missing qualified renderer stays pending/unsupported.

cases.name: render-receipt
cases.expectation: Mismatched artifact bytes/version/page range or incomplete inspection receipt cannot validate an artifact or download target.

cases.name: abort-before
cases.expectation: Aborted/expired invocation allocates no child/object/version; construction/import starts no effects.

cases.name: late-generation
cases.expectation: Executor returns after original deadline: no publication; owned cleanup attempted; returned bytes retained only as bounded failure evidence.

cases.name: late-authority
cases.expectation: Authorization returns late or missing/false/stale: no next noncleanup port.

cases.name: late-storage
cases.expectation: Storage/CAS returns after deadline: cannot report clean no-effect or accepted publication; ownership and uncertainty preserved.

cases.name: process-capture
cases.expectation: Both stream caps, true EOF versus reader errors, nonzero exit and abort are recorded; local synthetic child groups settle.

cases.name: temporary-ownership
cases.expectation: Cleanup removes only owned temporary resources; parent/original/borrowed files remain; cleanup failure not hidden.

cases.name: download-integrity
cases.expectation: Current exact-version download validates actual bytes/hash/length and media/name; wrong object version or partially read bytes refuse.

cases.name: filing-separation
cases.expectation: Generation success does not imply source filing/indexing; canonical artifact.file command and per-object persisted/failed semantics unchanged.

cases.name: coverage
cases.expectation: All four selected operation IDs remain in coverage ledger, with explicit unsupported PDF/import edits/general code/recalc/render/PPT dependencies as applicable.
